verdict.rationale: Multilingual parsing is a fair axis for a document-parsing product, but the evidence pack never mentions language support, CJK, or right-to-left scripts. The generative OCR and VLM partitioning items describe general text fidelity, not non-English parity, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English
